title: Zeroth-order parallel sampling
summary: Finding effective ways to exploit parallel computing to accelerate Markov chain Monte Carlo methods is an important problem in Bayesian computation and related disciplines. In this paper, we consider the zeroth-order setting where the unnormalized target distribution can be evaluated but its gradient is unavailable for theoretical, practical, or computational reasons. We also assume access to $m$ parallel processors to accelerate convergence.
